description.p: OpenTubeX is an open-source desktop YouTube client. It plays videos without advertisements and does not load Google's website, cookies or JavaScript.

Playback controls include per-channel speed and quality settings, SponsorBlock, silence skipping, tabs, multiple windows and a watch queue. Subscriptions, playlists, profiles, history and settings are stored locally, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync.

On first launch, OpenTubeX automatically downloads a managed copy of yt-dlp from the official yt-dlp releases and stores it inside the application's private data directory. The Flatpak runtime provides FFmpeg and FFprobe, which OpenTubeX uses from the system path instead of downloading managed copies. These tools support yt-dlp playback and media downloads; the default built-in playback engine does not depend on them. Automatic tool updates can be changed in the External Software settings.
OpenTubeX is currently in beta. This package uses the official portable Linux build published by the OpenTubeX project.

ul.li: The app takes on Material 3 Expressive, with rounder corners, tinted buttons and selections, springier motion, and bolder titles. Custom themes keep working.

A bell in the top bar keeps your live stream reminders, new uploads, and automatic downloads, which appear in the app instead of as system notifications while you use OpenTubeX. A new setting in General switches notifications to system only or off.
Exporting and importing large backups no longer freezes the app while the archive is created or read.
The cast menu lists the devices of every casting protocol together and, while casting, becomes a remote with seek and volume sliders, playback buttons, and subtitle choices.
You can now pin and unpin channels from their context menus.
Channels with TV shows now have a Shows tab. You can hide it in Distraction Free settings.
Right-clicking a collapsed tab group now opens a menu to expand it, close its tabs, or ungroup them.
Delete Old History on the History page can now delete your entire watch history with the new "All time" option.
The Material accent color picker now offers your system accent color, and the app follows it when you change it.
The About page and the update prompt now link to the new donation page, where you can support OpenTubeX through GitHub Sponsors or Liberapay.
Videos from other sites now work more like YouTube videos, with transcripts when they have captions and the same side panels and phone sheets.
Large watch histories and playlists are faster to edit, mark as watched, and sync.
OpenTubeX starts faster and stays responsive while loading a large watch history.
Layout settings in Appearance are now split into groups such as Interface, Tabs, Scrolling, and Notifications, and their switches, like those for video lists, sit in two columns.
OpenTubeX no longer contacts api.invidious.io at startup unless it uses a random Invidious instance.
Long YouTube playlists open and play without first downloading every page. Later pages load when playback, the playlist panel, or the progress bar reaches them.

Long video and playlist titles in lists and grids now stop after two lines with an ellipsis, so cards line up more evenly. Hover over a title to see all of it, or turn off Limit titles to two lines in Appearance settings.
32-bit ARM (armv7l) Linux builds are no longer available, because Electron no longer supports them. 64-bit ARM (arm64) builds are still available.
The watch queue and transcripts of long videos open and scroll smoothly even with hundreds of queued videos or thousands of transcript lines.
Menus, tooltips, and dialogs now follow Material 3, with accent-colored icons and smooth open and close animations. Dialogs and bottom sheets also blur the page behind them.

A new layout setting hides in-app notifications that only confirm an action or report a status. Errors, warnings, reminders, and notifications with an action like Undo still appear, and background progress shows in the progress bar.
In the phone layout, the description now opens from a button like Comments, with a two-line excerpt and chips for its music, games, tags, and content labels.
More menus open as bottom sheets on phones, including the channel setting, cast, subscription settings, comment filter, comment sort, and "More options" menus.
Videos in the watch page playlist have a one-tap Remove from playlist button on their thumbnails again. Add to playlist moved into each video's menu.
The chapters panel next to the video now has a resize handle like the playlist panel, so you can drag it taller to see more chapters at once. It remembers the size you choose.
RSS feeds can now refresh automatically. New items are marked as new and show in the New feed, and items have a menu to open, download, or mark them as watched.
The RSS feed manager can now browse RSSHub, so picking an instance, a service and a username fills in the feed address. Feeds from sites that ask for a browser check now say so.
Checking for updates downloads far less data, about 0.4 MB instead of 5 MB when you're up to date.

A channel's subscription settings and the Subscription settings manager use chips you can toggle, keep the notification choices visible while the bell is off, and set the daily video limit with a stepper.
Watch progress of media opened by link, such as videos from other websites, now syncs between your devices along with your history.

The Ocean themes are now Tally Light and Tally Dark, matching the website's new look. Their accent color defaults to red and can be changed to a preset, a custom color, or your system's accent color where available.
Twitch live chat uses less CPU in busy channels.
With the Local API, Up Next now shows when a video is a collaboration between several channels. Middle-clicking a collaboration's channel names now lists the collaborators instead of doing nothing.
You can now set the height of vertical tabs in Appearance settings.
The new Video descriptions setting in Distraction Free settings and Quick Settings hides descriptions, keeps them collapsed, or opens them expanded.
The App font list opens right away instead of freezing for several seconds when many fonts are installed.
When playback drops frames, automatic quality now steps down to a lower resolution of the same codec instead of switching to a codec that is harder to decode, such as AV1.
Captions grow and shrink with the player, so they cover the same share of the video in a window, in fullscreen, and in the mini player.
Older completed, queued, and paused downloads no longer disappear from Downloads after a restart, and a download whose files can't all be removed stays listed with an error message.
Downloaded videos now start playing within a few seconds when YouTube can't be reached, even while the rest of the internet works. Their details fill in once YouTube responds again.
A missing or wrong external player now shows a message that it couldn't be started instead of crashing OpenTubeX with an error dialog.
Failed or incomplete comment loads now offer a retry instead of reporting no comments or repeatedly retrying. The phone comments panel no longer duplicates its refresh and sort controls.
Invidious instances with special characters such as @, spaces, or % in the username or password of their URL now sign in correctly.
Buttons, selected controls, and accent-colored highlights are now easier to read with light main and secondary colors, such as Light Blue, Pink, and Green.
The app no longer crashes when you press a menu shortcut, such as Ctrl+, to open the settings, after watching a video.

When Start Videos Automatically is off, the next playlist or recommended video now starts after the countdown or Play Now, while videos you open yourself stay paused. Looping a playlist with one video now replays it every time.
Videos with captions in your preferred caption language now show those captions instead of the auto-translation you last picked in the player.
Videos and Shorts no longer take minutes to open while YouTube rate-limits your connection, and other requests no longer stall behind one that cannot succeed.
Setting Reduced Motion to Force off now brings back every animation when your system asks for reduced motion, and Force on stops the remaining tab, sheet and gesture animations.
RSS feeds that loaded before no longer reload after a restart when Fetch Feed on Startup is off, and show their saved items instead.
A failed search history import no longer erases your existing search history.
Videos keep loading at their selected quality on slow or high-latency connections, instead of dropping to 360p and reloading over and over.
Background subscription refresh no longer reports errors for channels without Shorts, live streams, or posts, or mistakes their regular uploads for Shorts or live streams.
Focus settings have a new Digital Wellbeing tab with a grayscale mode, daily watch time and Shorts limits, break reminders, and a bedtime reminder that can silence upload notifications.
The Playlists icon in the navigation, tabs, and page headings is now outlined to match the other navigation icons.
When a package manager installed OpenTubeX, the update prompt now shows its update command with a Copy button instead of a link to the website.
Subscription groups can now have an icon, shown beside the group's name in the group tabs and the subscribe button's group list.
You can now choose how many search history entries and suggestions the search bar shows before its list scrolls, from 5 to 50, in Appearance settings.
Chapters now have a loop button that repeats the chapter with A-B repeat. Press it again to stop.
You can keep the window open when you close its last tab. Turn off "Close window when closing the last tab" in General settings, and a new tab opens in its place.
Follow creators from other platforms through RSS and Atom feeds, for example from an RSSHub instance, in an optional RSS tab on the Subscriptions page. Turn it on in the subscription settings.
YouTube playlists, including saved ones, now have the "Search for Videos" field. Searching loads the rest of the playlist so the results cover every video.
The actions below a video stay in one row of evenly sized buttons on narrow screens, and the actions that don't fit move to a More options menu.

Caption font size and background opacity have sliders again, in the captions menu next to common values and in the settings. Font sizes go from 50% to 400% and opacities from 0% to 100%, both in 5% steps.
Caption settings show color swatches, and the sample caption previews each option as you hover over or move through it.

Place each player control on the control bar, in the player menu, or nowhere, and reorder the player menu. Resolution, playback speed, audio tracks, loop, screenshot and chapters can now go on the control bar, and you can hide any player menu entry, such as ambient mode, the sleep timer or captions.
Screenshots can be saved as JPEG XL. The format picker now lists legacy and modern formats separately.
When the video actions below the player share a narrow row, the download button now sits at the end, after the More button.
Afrikaans, Esperanto, and Urdu are now available as display languages.
The Distraction Free settings category is now called Focus, and every settings category describes what it contains more accurately.
Dropdown menus, tooltips, and color pickers in the settings window now open next to their button in Firefox instead of off to the side.
Captions keep one size at font sizes other than 100%, instead of growing word by word and spilling past their background.
Video lengths past 24 hours now include days, such as 1:01:01:01, matching the player.
The tab bar now scrolls to the active tab when the app opens, when you switch tabs with the keyboard, and when you open a new tab, so the active tab stays visible.
Tooltips now stay where they open instead of following the pointer, and appear centered below buttons and navigation items.
The reminder button on upcoming videos is filled with the accent color again while a reminder is set, so it's easy to tell on from off.
The audio track menu no longer resets while a video plays, so dragging its scrollbar keeps scrolling.
Menus no longer end with an empty separator line, for example the More menu of a YouTube playlist.
The player menu in the Customize interface preview now looks like the real one, with centered tiles, and shows a list when the grid layout is turned off.
Channel About pages now show links whose address leaves out https://.
The default playback speed is now rounded to two decimal places, so changing the speed step no longer leaves values such as 1.1500000000000001.
When using Invidious, the arrow keys now reach the About tab on channel pages.
The update prompt and store listings now leave out changes that only affect other platforms.

Mono Audio plays both audio channels in both ears, for videos whose sound only comes out of one side of your headphones. Turn it on in Player settings, or enable Show Mono Audio Toggle to switch it from the player menu.
The preferred video codec setting in Advanced settings is now available on every device, and its tooltip explains how AV1, VP9 and H.264 differ in data use, battery use and resolution.
Comments from channels you're subscribed to now show a person-with-checkmark badge instead of the OpenTubeX logo, and the badge also appears when using Invidious.

Options in the player's captions menu now opens a Style page for the font, text color and opacity, size, background color and opacity, edge style, and position. Player settings offer the same options and stay in sync, but vertical position and edge color are no longer available.
Videos in the built-in player start loading up to a second sooner.
Twitch VODs list all of their qualities in the quality menu again, instead of only the one that's playing, and start in your default quality even when that's the source quality.
Ending a SponsorBlock segment at the end of a video no longer fills in an end time past the video's length.
Videos from sites such as Dailymotion no longer fail with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'includes')" right after they start loading.
Paused videos no longer repeat the server countdown and reload when YouTube stops sending media after the first minute.
Dropdown menus, tooltips, and other popups in Firefox now open next to their button on scrolled pages instead of somewhere else on the screen.
Seeking during playback no longer plays a split second of audio at the new position twice.
When the tabs in the top or bottom tab bar overflow, they now sit centered in the bar with equal space above and below, instead of hugging one edge.
Buttons such as Cancel in pop-up messages are now readable with light themes.
A horizontal scrollbar no longer flashes when a Short returns from the mini player.
Creating or editing a subscription group opens quickly even with many subscriptions, and the scrollbar no longer jumps while scrolling through its channels.
Videos in the built-in player stop buffering after about a minute much less often.
When YouTube blocks a video for signed-out users because it features minors, the error message now says so instead of only suggesting an IP block.
Copying a playlist or adding several videos to a playlist at once no longer fails when a video has collaborators.
Downloaded videos no longer get stuck loading until you seek when "Buffer Before Playing" is set above 0, for example with the Smooth Playback buffering preset.
The hint for videos that need cookies now points to Settings → Advanced → External Software → yt-dlp Cookies.
Videos in the queue now sit centered in their rows, with even spacing and thumbnails aligned to the drag handles, even beside long titles.
Verified and official artist badges now stay beside the end of long channel names instead of wrapping onto a line of their own.
Queued videos now show their length, music badge, views and upload date like playlist videos. A ⋮ menu moves or removes them, and dragging slides the other videos aside.
Removed the "Match top bar with main color" setting, which made the header hard to read with many themes
Added configurable SponsorBlock submission shortcuts, with ; to start or end a segment and ' to open the submission menu.
The buttons below the video are easier to tap on touch screens
Quick Settings now start with playback speed and watch history instead of language, region, main color and thumbnail size. If you never customized Quick Settings, you get the new set automatically.
DeArrow now has its own section in Add-ons settings, and SponsorBlock's excluded channels only appear while SponsorBlock is enabled.
Player settings are now grouped into sections, and long select labels are no longer cut off
The date, views and category below the video now use icons, like video cards.
Tooltips now use your theme's colors, font and corner rounding instead of the plain system style
F-Droid, SideStore, Flatpak and FlatPark listings now show what's new in each stable release, and the deb, rpm and AUR packages include it as their changelog
Dragging the seek bar shows a strip of frames around where you'll land, and fullscreen swipe-to-seek now shows the same seek bar preview instead of a popup in the middle of the screen.
Round icon buttons, such as Share, Refresh and the download actions, now use soft tinted backgrounds instead of bright filled circles with shadows
On Android, links from other sites shared with OpenTubeX now open with yt-dlp, and video links from popular sites such as Instagram, TikTok and Reddit can open directly in the app

Show verified and official artist badges, YouTube's search spelling corrections, the music credited in a video, shared community posts, information panels under videos, hashtag video and channel counts, and a Music tab on Trending

On Android, syncs now finish while the app is in the background, changes made while it is hidden reach your other devices without reopening it, and returning to the app no longer shows a false "Sync failed: timed out" message.
Press B to add the current video to your quick bookmark playlist or remove it, and Shift+S to save it to a playlist
Hashtag pages have a Shorts tab that keeps loading more Shorts
While dragging the seek bar, pull up past the middle of the strip of frames to seek precisely through longer videos, drag back down to return to normal seeking, and press Esc to cancel the drag.
Choose how much video loads ahead, stays loaded for rewinding, and must load before playing, with Data Saver, Default and Smooth Playback presets in Settings → Advanced → Buffering
New Always use backup media server setting in Advanced settings loads videos from YouTube's backup server right away, for example when your internet provider's cache is often slow
Import Playlists can import several YouTube Takeout playlist CSVs at once, with their original titles and descriptions when you also select playlists.csv
New Pause on Stream Recovery setting: when the player recovers from a stream error, it pauses and keeps the error on screen with a Copy button until you dismiss it
The Android and iOS apps keep tab thumbnails and channel avatars after a restart and show them offline, and you can see and clear this cache in Storage settings
The Seek history menu shows how long ago you left each position.
The Add to playlist prompt shows which videos you're adding, and its search, switches and sort fit in one row
Recommended for you now draws on your whole watch history and saved videos instead of repeating suggestions based on the same few videos, and uses more specific searches and topic labels
The comment filter and reload buttons are now the same size as the refresh button on the subscriptions pages

On Android, background tabs now stay loaded until memory runs low (adjustable in Advanced settings), tab previews no longer turn black while a page is loading, and the tab organizer button no longer stays highlighted after you pick a tab.
The Playback speed, Zoom, Volume boost and Theatre mode tiles in the player menu are highlighted while they are changed from their defaults
Sync finishes faster after small changes, and with an updated sync server, a watch history edit uploads only that entry instead of your whole history
The "Playing in Picture-in-Picture" message is now larger, centered on the player and shown with an icon
Pinching on Android no longer zooms the app interface with WebViews such as Vanadium

With the custom title bar, middle-clicking the empty tab strip opens a tab again on Windows, maximized Settings no longer puts buttons under the window controls, the screen's top edge reaches the tabs of a maximized window, and the window controls no longer cover a Full Window video on Windows
Android: Fullscreen entered by rotating the phone stays on when the next video starts
The resolution menu lists every codec a video is available in, including ones your device can only decode in software, such as AV1 on GPUs without AV1 decoding.
Keep video tab titles when a channel loads behind the video, and restore channel names when returning to their pages
Fixed missing comments and video descriptions when Android restores an open video at startup.
Fixed repeated player reloads, videos failing to load without thumbnail previews, and broken channel lists when video or TV-show details are incomplete.
Fixed comment sorting and reload buttons looking enabled while offline.
Retry timed-out stream format checks before completing playlist preloading.

Fixed overflowing playlist thumbnail controls with a three-dot menu for reorder and remove actions. Playlist videos now show icon-labeled metadata like the queue and retain available view counts. Playlist positions appear in the top-left corner of each thumbnail.
Fixed unnecessary SABR player reloads caused by split stream headers and limited buffering of oversized stream responses.
Fixed gray watch-page action icons so they use the light or dark theme foreground color.
Videos played through Invidious no longer show a false age-restricted badge

Fixed Load More on Home stopping after 96 videos, downloaded playlist videos streaming online after Next, missing Shorts notifications on Android while the app is closed, missing notifications for channels outside the active profile, SRT files with dot timestamps failing to load, playlist searches carrying over to the next playlist, Yattee error toasts on videos with comments turned off, and hidden windows not returning from the macOS Dock.
The description's "...more" and copy buttons no longer show through the share menu and other video toolbar menus
With theatre as the default viewing mode, chapters, the transcript and SponsorBlock open below the video again when the watch page has no sidebar
Swiping between tabs on the app bar no longer makes the incoming page jump to a different scroll position on Android
Subscribing to a channel no longer opens its subscription settings when you only have one profile.
The player preview in Customize interface now shows the center play button and the player menu while playing, and matches the compact controls and menu on phones and narrow windows
Videos on Android and iOS no longer wait up to 25 seconds for a SABR countdown before they start playing.
On narrow screens, the buttons below the video now split into one row per group instead of wrapping with a stray divider
Android: yt-dlp playback works after a fresh install even when GitHub limits update requests, because the app bundles a current yt-dlp and updates it without GitHub's rate-limited API
Tab Organizer previews on Android no longer miss channel banners and avatars that load after the page.
Fixed Android downloads and other yt-dlp features disappearing when the saved download history file was empty
Videos now start when YouTube's assigned media server doesn't respond, for example an unreachable cache at your internet provider, because OpenTubeX switches to the backup server YouTube names
Volume, brightness and speed indicators appear over the video instead of the middle of the screen when the queue or another side panel is open in fullscreen

Links in update release notes open in your browser again, and imported settings, backups and remote content are handled more safely. Download templates and the IP block recovery script are no longer exported, backed up or synced
Fixed a thin line of the page showing between the minimized player and the navigation bar on Android when UI Scale isn't 100%
Fixed YouTube Takeout ZIP imports finding no data when the export was in a language other than English

Linux: OpenTubeX no longer shows a main process error when the desktop session starts it while D-Bus is still slow, such as when KDE Plasma restores the previous session at login, and KDE Wayland minimize detection now recovers in that case
Links in prompts, fullscreen player panels and expanded Super Chat messages open in your browser, and theme author links open once and follow your External Link Handling setting
Managed yt-dlp and FFmpeg downloads now say when antivirus software removed or blocked the downloaded file, and their error messages are translated
The Settings window header border no longer gets thinner after scrolling a settings page
Player submenu titles, including Caption Appearance, are now vertically centered in their headers
AiSList now hides or flags collaboration videos when any of their channels is on the list
Search results now show upload times for auto-generated Topic videos
The Shorts transcript panel no longer shows a second scrollbar or cuts off its last lines.
Jumping to a setting from Account activity no longer opens its help tooltip, which got stuck at the top of the window
Scheduled live streams and premieres now stay where they were announced in the New feed, Home, the Live tab and Invidious feeds when Show Scheduled Live Streams / Premieres First is off
The buttons at the bottom of the captions menu now have rounded corners that fit inside the player menu
Videos released to everyone after a members-only period now show their public release date in Subscriptions and Home recommendations
Pressing Esc while a dialog or the command palette is open over a fullscreen video now closes it instead of leaving the app stuck behind a cut-off dialog
Members-only videos no longer appear on channel pages, in search, related videos or Home unless you turn on "Members only" in that channel's subscription settings
The music visualizer no longer goes flat on Android when a track is played again after it ends
Seeking a paused video that still shows its thumbnail now shows the video at the new position
YouTube links in a channel's About tab open in OpenTubeX instead of the browser
The grid player menu no longer grows to the full height of the player, and its pages keep their header in view while you scroll long lists like audio tracks or caption languages
Videos no longer loop through the server countdown for minutes when YouTube stops sending media after the first minute
Recently ended live streams without any built-in formats now fall back to yt-dlp or show an error instead of leaving the player area empty

Fixed the app staying offline when a network blocks the internet check, Invidious playlists on the watch page stopping after the first page, and YouTube Takeout imports cutting video titles or adding extra text to video IDs
